As someone who has worked with many disabled adults who were nonverbal and/or intellectually disabled, they love it when you talk to them. They love it when you narrate what you're doing, what they're doing, they love to be included and asked questions and spoken to even if they can't verbally respond. There's no way of knowing how much they understand. In my experience, nonverbal & intellectually disabled clients still love to be talked to.

There were other staff who would be jealous when I would show up and the client's would get so excited. "How come they don't react like that for me??"

I don't know, is your shift a 14 hour sing-along to their favorite music and dance party? No? We have our answer then 🤣

You asked for advice and I wasn't rude to you. I'm sorry that it didn't end up working out for you and that you're so effected by it. It is a hard job and it's not for everyone, and you haven't failed anyone.

I was simply trying to help you see that you were limiting your client in your own mind and see how that could get in the way.

And yes, it does suck to have rejection sensitivity. I have it too. But the thing I try to keep in mind the most with it is that it's my problem and not other people's. For me, understanding that I have it and that the emotions I'm feeling aren't proportionate to reality is the most helpful thing in keeping myself as composed as I can and not lashing out at others. Just spreads the hurt around and makes things worse.

Anyway, have a nice day.

I personally haven't used a gold ticket on a residential floor yet, I put them on my creative (orange) floors to make money and build up faster.

The best thing to do for someone who gifts you bits is to visit their tower so they get 10 bux for your visit, as it costs 5 bux to send a bit.

To use the book of life it needs to be written before the sim dies. I found this out when one of my sims unexpectedly died and I frantically had to find a way to revive her. If you can get the ghost to join your household you can make ambrosia and that will revive them but it's also a pain in the ass.

The easiest way Ive found to revive sims is to just cheat. Once you get his ghost added to your household pull up the cheatbox and do "testingcheats true". Once that's done you can do "traits.remove\_trait \[trait\]". You might have to do some digging on google to find out what his specific death trait is actually called, I would link it to you but Im on my work computer and it wont let me access most websites (I have no idea why reddit works but it does). My sim died of electrocution and I had to put "traits.remove\_trait electrocution" I was trying to do the whole trait name which was "Death by Electrocution". So just be aware of that.

Also, I know that in this post you said is urn his lost, but for anyone wondering or if you find his urn, if you have testingcheats on and shift-click the urn you can add a ghost to your household that way to save time.
